finalText:
The build is clean now: 0 errors, exit code 0. The dependency bump changed two call sites, and I fixed both.

- `src/core/options.js:7` — the new bundler passes `{ retryCount }`, but this code still read `options.retries`, which is `undefined`. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:8` — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. The strict check treated `undefined` as an error. Added an `undefined` case that returns `false`, same as the old default.

The hundreds of `DEP0*` and `WARN`/`note` lines earlier are just deprecation noise from the bumped packages, not the cause of the failure — they don't block the build. The real breakage was the two link-stage bugs above.
